title: Store Owes Woman Money After Applying Coupons To Her $1,161 Shop | Extreme Couponing
description: By using her endless supply of coupons and discounts, Missy manages to buy $1161 of shopping, and end up only paying $4.53, including picking up some extra items for free when the store owes her money!  Subscribe to TLC UK for more great clips: https://www.youtube.com/c/TLCTVUK   Like TLC UK on Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/uktlc/  Follow TLC UK on Twitter: https://twitter.com/tlc_uk?lang=en  Visit our website: http://www.uk.tlc.com/

asr.full_text: The retail value of all the coupons is approximately 2 million dollars. American shoppers save around three billion dollars a year each year using coupons. Supreme coupon collector Missy has around 14,000 in her collection. And just look at what she's amassed. My name's Missy and I love shopping with coupons. Couponing is not just grocery shopping for me. It's a way of life. I just get up every day and try and make the most out of what God gives me. My latest find is cat treats that paid me 60 cents a bag. Funny thing is we don't own a cat. Now why do you need, oh never mind. Missy collects up to 5,000 coupon inserts from the papers every week. Her collection is so big she's knocked down a wall to make, wait for it, a coupon storage room. I love my coupon room and I'm able to store thousands upon thousands of inserts in there. The room is about four feet tall and it goes on forever. And I'm often asked where I receive all of my inserts from and I simply have one answer and that's from God. This gift from above has enabled Missy to store up to $75,000 worth of shopping. That's almost 10,000 items for a family of ten. This is my daughter-in-law's favorite spot in the house, this is where I keep her favorite soda. We have over 300 bottles. Missy's inventory also includes 800 jars of baby food, 200 tubes of cleaning wipes and 1,200 packs of batteries. We were able to purchase these noodles and they paid us 21 cents for every two we took home. We brought home 1,000 of them six hundred went straight to a food bank Missy also coupons to support American soldiers working overseas. I have a son that's in the military and so it's very near and dear to our hearts so my family and I have sponsored several young men that are currently serving overseas and I have a running total of what they like as far as the toothpaste they live and their favorite deodorant so they don't just have to settle for what I have I make sure that I get what they want we're going to see how much stuff we could fill up these batteries with and we're going to see how much we'll have to donate at the end of the day that's our goal so today Missy is aiming to get double her usual shop and is heading to the supermarket with BFF Tammy and her accordion folder full of coupons a day's trip is going to be a great haul it's going to be one of the best ones yet first thing on the list is some nighttime pain pain reliever. It's not just pre, missy's being paid to buy it. Gives me a headache just thinking about it. Yay! There it is. And how many do we have? 112. I think we should dump it. The pain reliever retails for $5.99 but The shop has it on sale at $1 99 with mrs. $2 50 coupon each bottle she tries will make her 51 cents we are gonna make $51 on this somewhere else girl we are doing good next up the first item in daughter and or Linda's stockpile detergent so we're gonna need another buggy we're starting our train so we're gonna get fifty four bottles let's go get some diapers Linda will be pleased now what's the deal in the diaper department there is sales tax on this you need to account for it on our calculations so we don't have to pay it at the end why are we getting diapers the twins are out of diapers aren't they they're free and, my grandson will be using those. I received in the mail a package that included a free coupon. So make sure you're signing up for everything you can online, because you can get all kinds of free coupons. Missy picks up a few items to balance out some of the credit she's accumulated, then it's off to the checkouts. Hi, how are you? Good, how are you? Doing fabulous. I'm very organized and methodical on how I do the checkout process. I've put all my life items together. I've never seen anybody buy this many laundry detergents. We're at 913. Free tax. We're doing good. Hold on a minute. There's big problems for Missy when the painkillers cause the till to stop scanning. I can't scan anymore of these items. Let me go talk to my manager and see what she wants me to do about it. And I'll be right back. It's not gonna let me do over a hundred. Okay, well let's go ahead and try and see if I can override this then. And that's gonna be a big negative. Houston, we have a problem. We certainly do. If Missy can't buy all 114 bottles of painkillers, she won't accumulate the saving she needs to get some free meat. They have a limit on how many items that you can scan of one particular bar code. So what we're going to do is we're going to move all of those, the extra 14, over to a second transaction the things that we were getting with the overage we'll to scoot that over to. Problem solved Missy saves the day. The total is $1,061.40 Seeing the balance of over a thousand dollars you're like oh my goodness do I really have that many coupons to cover what I've put up there? With a thousand dollar total that she wants to pay under ten dollars for, Missy watches like a hawk ensuring each coupon is scanned properly. There's no flies on our Missy. It can be quite costly if you don't watch. Coupons stick together and you're not counting what's actually scanned. The anticipation mounts as crowds gather to learn the grand total. Here's my savings card. And they watch again as the bill dramatically falls. As you can see, her balance here on the total is negative 884. We actually owe her money. How do you do that? Coupons, thats how. But the shop won't actually give customers money, so Missy can use her credit to buy non-couponed items, such as meat. We are going to take care of the overage that we have here. What we are going to do is go ahead and pay for it with the meat. You saved 1064 dollars064.42 today. And the total is $2.62. But there's more. Missy still has 14 bottles of painkillers that need scanning. $1.91. And to this order you save $96.80. Thank you. We spent $4 and 53 cents and we saved $1,161 and 22 cents. Please tell me you're bound. After using her credit to buy her meat, the grand total of both missus transactions which includes 54 bottles of detergent, 114 bottles of painkillers and four bottles of non-dairy creamer comes to $1,161.22. But with her coupons, Missy paid just $4.53. I've never seen anybody save that much money. All right, gang, time to unload the car. Let's see what we got in our haul today. Missy will add a lot of her haul to her own stockpile, some will go to local charities and she will give some to daughter-in-law Linda to start her stockpile. I'm a person that needs to be needed and so I very much enjoy being able to provide for other folks. A little start for my stock, huh? Yeah, you betcha. Knowing that they depend on me, you know makes makes me feel good inside.

The goods are described as being used for household stockpiling, family support, and local charity donations rather than offered as an investment, paid service, credential exchange, or money-making scheme. The request to subscribe to TLC UK is ordinary channel engagement and is not linked to financial participation.

The evidence describes a shopping transaction for household goods rather than an investment, paid earning service, credential request, or scam mechanism.
